summary.title: When Leonard leaves IL, drop Fears (not Bailey)
summary.headline: Leonard (O, IL) is expected back ~Oct 28; then 14 healthy players for 13 spots: drop Fears, keep Bailey.
summary.verdict: The season sim now rates Bailey well above Fears: dropping Bailey costs about 2 pp of playoff odds versus dropping Fears. Nothing to do until Leonard's tag clears.
risks: Fears is a young guard whose role could grow; in-season projections have seen only a week of games.
Deltas are vs a replacement-level pickup (sim IL-replacement baseline); P(title) differences are noise.
Executed only after Leonard's O tag clears on Yahoo, and only before the players' games that day (Yahoo #174).
rationale: - Fears has the lowest season value on the roster (-0.57 per game, opportunity detector's drop rule).
- Paired season sims, 3 seeds x 8000 each, season-sim-0.8.1, ros-proj-0.5.0 in-season projections.
- The sim's roster cap already cuts Fears in ~65% of runs when Leonard returns: the model agrees.

why_now.before: Bailey has been the planned drop since 10-22/10-24 (Champagnie for Bailey, approved by you). That compared Bailey with Champagnie, never with Fears.

changed.text: Champagnie was added without a drop (open IL spot), so the question is now Bailey vs Fears, which we had not simulated.
In-season projections (ros-proj-0.5.0, a week of box scores) and season-sim-0.8.1 replace the draft-time numbers.
